---
description: "Create or update a feature's spec.md from a short description"
agent: spec
argument-hint: "<feature slug and short description>"
---

Create (or update) `spec/features/<slug>/spec.md` for the feature described
below, using [spec/templates/spec.template.md](../../spec/templates/spec.template.md).
Ask clarifying questions before finalizing Goals/Non-Goals/Requirements if
the description leaves scope ambiguous.
